extension.summary: Explicit local H.264/AAC through the CrystalHD research V4L2 node
extension.description: Optional Kodi 22 RC1 experiment. Progressive H.264 MP4 through the actual CrystalHD V4L2 decoder, one copy into Kodi-owned YUY2 buffers; AAC via Kodi. Requires the separate research module. No internal software decoder fallback, zero-copy or standard nonempty STOP/START support claim.
